tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The TEC brand colour. Fills: primary buttons, the app sidebar, newsletter header and footer, date blocks, title slides. Text on it is on-navy.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of navy fills; the service grid's column header row; deep panels in print.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy and navy-deep (8.1:1 light, 6.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-navy-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy: nav links, footer lines, captions (6.5:1 light, 5.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The accent. Fills, plus small capitals on navy (4.7:1 light, 4.5:1 dark); never text on white or surface: the current nav item, the short rule under section headings, the lime pill button, the Wins banner, progress fills. Text on it is on-lime.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime (9.7:1 light, 11.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for app-filled content and named people on the grid; text on it is on-lime-soft.

tokens.name: on-lime-soft
tokens.usage: Text on lime-soft (9.6:1 light, 10.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, form panels, email body.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet highlight panels: the Pastor's word, helper boxes, selected rows, info chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders and table rules. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and checkboxes (3:1 or more on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (14.7:1 or more light, 13:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: helper text, metadata, table headers, on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (6.1:1 or more light, 6.9:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, eyebrows and navy text on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint (7.2:1 or more light, 6.8:1 or more dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element (3:1+ on all surfaces in both themes).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text and icons: Received, Covered, Active, Pass. Always with a word, never colour alone. On ok-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of success chips and notices.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Attention text: unfilled slots, awaiting approval, gaps. On warn-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of attention chips and notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocking text: Overdue, over limit, approval blocked. Always with a word. On danger-soft or the surfaces.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of blocking chips and notices.

tokens.name: neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of neutral chips (Draft, Paused, Not started); text on it is ink-muted.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (Active).

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (Occasional).

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (New).

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (Inactive). Orange, so it differs from data-1 in lightness and hue.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (Paused) and 'other'.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Title slides, posters, social posts. One per surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles in the app; the newsletter's issue headline.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Headline numbers in stat tiles. Use tabular figures.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Newsletter section titles, slide headings, print section titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles in the app.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small label above a title. Set in capitals, in link or lime-on-navy.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We are organising a G-Squad meeting for all workers.
styles.usage: Newsletter and email body, printed handouts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Roles come from each Sunday's service grid.
styles.usage: App body text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in tables, emphasised values, button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Opted-in members only · day and month
styles.usage: Helper text, chip labels, table headers (in capitals, 0.04em tracking), footnotes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside chips and between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls and buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; gap between stat tiles on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields; minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a column.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Email and print section spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Safe margin on social posts and slides.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Nav items, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, rota cells, notices, date blocks in tables.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, newsletter blocks, date blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Phone sheets and the email container.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, RSVP buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Phone bottom sheets and menus only. Cards use a line border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every button, input and tappable row.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: App sidebar width on desktop; stacks above content on phones.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of app content.

tokens.name: email-width
tokens.usage: Newsletter email body width.
